svg.title: layout-ruler demo terminal
svg.desc: Terminal session running layout-ruler on six demo pages at 1280 and 375 pixels wide: the aligned list passes, and each other page fails on its one planted fault with the measured pixels printed: ragged status dots, an uneven 14px gap, a 56px row among 48px rows, a cell 4px below its row's baseline, and a banner that runs off the phone screen.
